Google Pixel 11 Pro XL Review is here
In this video, we take an in-depth look at Google’s latest flagship and see what it actually feels like to use.
The Pixel 11 Pro XL comes with a stunning 6.8-inch display, Tensor G6 processor, unique RGB lights, 5X telephoto camera with up to 120X Super Res Zoom, and a 5115mAh battery.
In this review, we cover the design, RGB lighting, display quality, performance, cameras, 120X zoom, battery life, and overall Pixel experience.
